mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1500 units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence indices
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of instances when HOUST > 1500, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 4.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS < 4.5% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.2% signals a tightening labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between UNRATE and labor market indicators
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 30% of instances when UNRATE < 4.2, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 110 signals increased economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only when accompanied by a rise in PAYEMS above 135000.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between INDPRO and PAYEMS
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 35% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 2.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in real disposable income (RSAFS) above 370000 signals increased consumer spending power, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between RSAFS and consumer spending
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 45% of instances when RSAFS > 370000, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) below 200 signals reduced inflationary pressures, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during monetary tightening cycles.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.035 over any 2-year rolling window during tightening cycles, or 20-day forward returns when CPIAUCSL < 200 are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during those cycles.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 137500, accompanied by a rise in UNRATE above 4.8, signals a labor market shift, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between PAYEMS and UNRATE
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained GDP growth rate (GDPC1) above 4% signals robust economic activity, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, regardless of the regime.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 2.5-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when GDPC1 > 4% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
